forgiving_trigger
</NAME>

<DESCRIPTION>
Keeps cooperative play against never-defecting opponents and punishment after defection, while forgiving an apparent two-round retaliation once the opponent resumes cooperation. This can recover mutual cooperation with opponents that briefly defect in response to conflict.
</DESCRIPTION>

<CODE>
```python
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START
def policy(own_history, opponent_history):
    return 0 if len(opponent_history) == 0 or opponent_history.count(1) == 0 or (opponent_history.count(1) == 2 and opponent_history[-1] == 0) else 1
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END
```
